cohort: The study included 255 women admitted with early-onset severe preeclampsia (before 34 weeks' gestation) to a single tertiary center between 2013 and 2019, excluding those with intrauterine or neonatal demise or missing breastfeeding data.
finding: Among patients with early-onset severe preeclampsia, tobacco use in pregnancy was associated with noninitiation of breastfeeding at hospital discharge, while maternal age under 20 years and experiencing maternal morbidity were associated with cessation of breastfeeding by the routine postpartum visit.
